name: quadcopter-wind-hover
$comment: The quadcopter of the mission model hovering at 1 m in a steady 4 m/s wind (no turbulence): the settled tilt is the static drag balance of design.wind_tilt. Generated by design/build_model.py.

connections.label: pose chart (qw qx qy qz x y z)

plots.title: Attitude (rad): roll, pitch, yaw and yaw set-point
Roll rate: set-point, estimate and truth (rad/s)
Tracking error: distance to the set-point (m)
Wind at the airframe (m/s): x, y and the discrete gust

parameters.name: wind_x
parameters.description: Mean wind, world x (the wind blows towards +x)

parameters.name: wind_sigma
parameters.description: Turbulence: standard deviation of the Gaussian gusts (a new one every 0.5 s, 1 s lag)

parameters.name: gust_speed
parameters.description: Peak speed of the discrete 1-cos gust (0: off)

parameters.name: gust_dir
parameters.description: Direction the gust blows towards (world, from +x; 90 = +y)
